task: Make the CLI Insights user-details Total Cost and Est. Monthly figures reconcile with the spend-ledger CLI cost shown in the filtered overview and user row (same identity/project/date filters), qualifying or hiding them when unreliable, with regression tests.

key_reasoning.reason: CLI Insights detail payload and key-metric cards in the insights handler, the coupled classification/rule-reason and repository-cost path (classification engine), read-only reuse of the shared ledger group-spend and report-filter utilities, plus the UI tab-to-modal identity hand-off and card presentation in the sibling codemie-ui repo: 3-4 components across 2-3 layers with shared utilities involved.

Backend: insights handler, possibly classification engine and CLI constants, analytics service delegation, and the large CLI handler test module; UI: CLIInsightsTab, user-details modal, detail-param helpers, detail hook and their tests. Roughly 8-10 modified files across 3+ directories spanning two repos, 0-2 new.

Scored M, not S: the exact per-user CLI ledger read pattern exists (_cli_spend_by_user) and the RenderedSpend/spend_* qualification vocabulary and forecast-state tests already exist, so no auto-bump for security or edge-case test gaps; but behaviour depends on the ledger coverage floor, detail spend also drives classification/rule reasons, and 8 detail endpoints each recomputing the payload risk multiplying ledger reads.

Acceptance criteria are concrete (reconcile to ledger, same filters/identity, hide-or-qualify, estimate distinguished, regression tests), but open decisions remain: hide vs mark unavailable, whether classification and repository cost follow the new source, and how the backend/UI split is drawn.

Consistent with the bundled M example epmcdme-10203 (total 15, three-layer change on established pattern); this task scores higher on component scope and file count because of the cross-repo UI hand-off and coupled classification path.
